# @msameim181/iran-map-core

> Framework-free TypeScript data and logic for an Iran SVG map: provinces, counties, capitals, Persian and English names, islands and seas.

The root entry exports model builders, types, selection, color and tooltip helpers without importing map data.
Pass catalogs to `buildMapModel(options, catalogs)` and render the resulting SVG paths in your own UI.
The coordinate space is 1000 × 825. The core has no React, Vue or DOM dependency.

Install from npm with `npm install @msameim181/iran-map-core`; no token is required. Use `/lean` for provinces
and province capitals, `/full` for all catalogs, or individual catalog entries. `standard`, `lite` and `mini`
provide lighter geometry. Import `@msameim181/iran-map-core/styles.css` in the app for the supplied styles.

The package family includes the React and Vue renderers linked below. For rendering roles and tooltips, read
Rendering notes; for source-data licenses, read NOTICE. Core model building runs in Node without a DOM.

داده‌های نقشه ایران برای ساخت نقشه تعاملی شامل استان، شهرستان و مراکز استان با نام‌های فارسی است.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/main/README.md): Installation, catalogs, API and rendering notes.
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and npm provenance publishing.
- [API and helpers](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#api): Model options, return shape and exported helpers.
- [Entry points](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#entry-points): Logic, catalog, data-level and CSS imports.
- [Public types](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/src/interfaces.ts): Models, catalogs, values and shared wrapper types.
- [Root exports](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/src/index.ts): Exported types and functions.
- [Rendering notes](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#rendering-notes): Styles, SVG roles, tooltip ids and capital geometry.

## Install

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@msameim181/iran-map-core): Public npm install; no token needed.
- [Install instructions](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#install): npm command.
- [GitHub Packages alternative](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#from-github-packages-alternative): Authenticated scope-registry setup.

## Examples

- [Minimal usage](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#minimal-usage): Province model and capital markers with the lean catalogs.
- [Catalog usage](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/README.md#usage): Individual catalogs, full preset and lazy-loaded counties.
- [Data-level comparison](https://msameim181.github.io/iran-map-core/): Full, standard, lite and mini geometry.
- [Model tests](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/tests/common.test.ts): Counties, regions, colors, focus and tooltips.
- [Catalog tests](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-core/blob/main/tests/catalogs.test.ts): Injected catalogs and missing-catalog warnings.
